1. Our commitment

Online Saathi is operated by Shubhlaxmi Multiservices India Private Limited. We respect your privacy and follow applicable Indian laws, regulations and guidelines. Your trust is central to our services.

2. Information we collect

2.1 User information

Name, mobile number, email, date of birth, gender and profile photo.

2.2 Member information

Current and permanent address; identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN, passport, citizenship or driving licence); occupation and education; marital status and location.

2.3 Business information (Saathis, partners, companies)

Registered business name, registration certificates, director details, business type, registered address, secondary contact, optional bank details, and business documents such as PAN, MOA, AOA and licences.

2.4 Job applicant information

Resume and cover letter, educational and professional qualifications, and references.

2.5 App permissions

  • Camera & photos — KYC and profile verification
  • SMS — sending and receiving transaction confirmations
  • Contacts — making number selection easier; contacts are not stored or shared
  • Location — finding nearby Saathis and services
  • Internet — completing transactions smoothly

3. How we use information

  • Verifying your identity
  • Facilitating services and transactions
  • Sending service updates and offers
  • Providing customer support
  • Improving the Platform
  • Detecting fraud and unauthorised activity
  • Complying with Indian regulatory authorities

4. Sharing and disclosure

We keep your information confidential and do not share it without your consent, except:

  • when required by law;
  • for fraud prevention and security;
  • with trusted partners bound by strict data protection agreements, to deliver the services you request.

5. Data retention and account deletion

We keep data only as long as needed for operational, legal and regulatory purposes. Inactive accounts (6 months to 3 years) may be deleted if the balance is zero, no transactions are pending and no fraud or misuse is detected. Job applicant data may be retained for evaluation after recruitment closes.

6. Data protection

We use industry-standard security, including encryption, secure servers and regular audits.

7. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal obligations. Significant changes will be communicated by SMS, email or in-app notification, and the latest version will always be available on this page.
